status_semantics.EXTERNAL_CAPABILITY_SPECIMEN_FOUND: An external system demonstrates the target behavior, but the operative mechanism remains external/opaque and is not Brain-owned.
status_semantics.REUSABLE_MECHANISM_IDENTIFIED: An already-existing reusable skill/procedure/workflow/algorithm/scaffold has been identified for internalization.
status_semantics.INTERNALIZATION_IN_PROGRESS: The reusable mechanism is being encoded/configured into Brain-owned artifacts.
status_semantics.BRAIN_CONFIGURED_VERIFICATION_PENDING: Brain owns the operative configuration, but >= Opus 5.5 verification is pending.
status_semantics.UNRESOLVED_THEORY_FALSIFICATION_CANDIDAT: No realizable existing reusable mechanism has been found under hard constraints.
